ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: There are two figures on the left and right in the diagram; the question asks about City Jia, so only look at the left figure. The title of the left figure is Jia, the horizontal axis represents the natural population growth rate, the vertical axis represents the population migration rate, and five periods from ① to ⑤ are marked on the curve. ① and ② are located in a state where the total growth rate is still negative; at ③, although the natural growth rate is still somewhat negative, the population migration rate is positive and has already exceeded the negative value of the natural growth rate. Then reason: The total population growth rate of City Jia = natural population growth rate + population migration rate. The sum of the two items for ① and ② is less than 0, so the population has not yet grown positively; by ③, the sum of the two items is greater than 0 for the first time, so the population of City Jia began to show positive growth in the 3rd period.
